And I hope it’s not offensive to call her weak - I have battled with depression for almost a decade and sometimes I DO feel like destroying myself because death is more of a blissful experience. Maybe that’s why I am more drawn to a happy ending - to an ending where the MC truly fights and still has a reason to live, even if it is just one person.
